title: The Upanishads — Īśāvāsya and Taittirīya study editions

work.title: Īśāvāsya Upaniṣad (Kāṇva recension, 18 mantras); Taittirīya Upaniṣad (3 vallīs, 31 anuvākas)

attribution.traditionalLocation: Īśā: Śukla Yajurveda, Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā 40 (Kāṇva Saṃhitā 40; Mādhyandina VS 40 has 17 mantras in another order). Taittirīya: Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda, Taittirīya Āraṇyaka 7–9

sources.label: GRETIL, Īśa-Upaniṣad, Kāṇva recension (Sansknet input; mūla checked against Limaye & Vadekar, Eighteen Principal Upaniṣads vol. 1, Poona 1958), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: The base text. Two corrections, both of spacing or avagraha position; no reading changed.

sources.label: Advaita Sharada (Śṛṅgeri), mūla of Śaṅkara's Īśāvāsyopaniṣad-bhāṣya, via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
Kāṇva Saṃhitā 40 with svara; Mādhyandina Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā 40 with svara and pada-pāṭha; the mūla of Madhva's and Vedānta Deśika's commentaries — github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: Collated letter by letter; every difference classified in upanishads/isha/edition/corrections.json. Svara shown only from the Kāṇva Saṃhitā witness, as keyed.

sources.label: Śaṅkara, Vedānta Deśika, Madhva (Īśāvāsyopaniṣad-bhāṣyas) and Mahīdhara (on VS 40), via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: The authorities for the traditional and comparative notes; every Sanskrit quotation is checked against them.

sources.label: Parallel passages from Advaita Sharada mūla files (Gītā, Upaniṣads, Brahmasūtra) and GRETIL (Ṛgveda, Bṛhadāraṇyaka, Māṇḍūkya); Pāṇini's sūtras from github.com/sanskrit/ashtadhyayi
sources.note: Every quoted phrase and every sūtra citation is checked against these.

sources.label: Advaita Sharada (Śṛṅgeri), mūla of Śaṅkara's Taittirīyopaniṣad-bhāṣya, via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts (vedAntam/advaitam/advaita-shAradA/mUla/Taitiriya.md)
sources.note: The Taittirīya base text. Twelve corrections of slips in the file (spacing, a dropped or doubled letter), each confirmed by the Sāyaṇa-pāṭha and Madhva's text; logged in upanishads/taittiriya/edition/corrections.json.

sources.label: Taittirīya Āraṇyaka 7–9, Sāyaṇa-pāṭha with svara; the mūla of Madhva's Taittirīyopaniṣad-bhāṣya — github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: Collated letter by letter (Madhva's text vallī by vallī, as it divides some anuvākas differently); every difference classified. Svara shown only from the Sāyaṇa-pāṭha, as keyed.

sources.label: Śaṅkara's Taittirīyopaniṣad-bhāṣya (Advaita Sharada, via sanskrit/raw_etexts); Madhva's bhāṣya and the six Viśiṣṭādvaita commentaries of the Melkote edition (Kūranārāyaṇa, Raṅgarāmānuja, Bhāradvāja-Rāmānuja, Rāmānanda, Gopālānanda, Kauśika Govindarāja), via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: The authorities for the Taittirīya's traditional and comparative notes; every Sanskrit quotation is checked against the named commentary on that anuvāka.

translation.note: Padaccheda, word tables, translations, explanations, commentary prose and studies were prepared for PaddySpeaks (upanishads/isha/edition/). They are not taken from a published translation; commentary is labelled by its authority.

verification.method: Automated proof, per edition: numbering without a gap (Īśā 18 mantras; Taittirīya 31 anuvākas, 51 units); text equal to the base witness apart from logged corrections; every letter difference of every other witness classified; every padaccheda rejoins by sandhi; every commentator quotation, parallel and Pāṇini citation found in its source; every analysed record has all fourteen sections.
verification.scope: the text, the collation and the analysis records

knownIssues.summary: Translations, explanations and commentary prose await review by a Sanskrit scholar; readings marked 'Verification required' (Kāṇva Saṃhitā witness in mantras 10 and 16, Madhva's text in 14) need a printed edition.

Taittirīya: the analysis is published vallī by vallī (Śīkṣāvallī first); the Brahmānanda- and Bhṛguvallī show the verified text with the analysis in preparation. All prose awaits review by a Sanskrit scholar.

recordedText: Īśā: GRETIL Isa-Upanisad, Kanva recension (Limaye & Vadekar 1958). Taittirīya: Advaita Sharada mūla (Śṛṅgeri)
statusNote: Texts machine-verified against their witnesses; analysis machine-checked for its sources; scholarly review pending.
